summary: Pre-market 2026-11-05, 07:30 ET. The last settled US session is 2026-11-04: after the Democrats swept the midterms, SPY closed up 1.6518 percent, yet the risk score is 63.77, still high_risk and 0.30 points below the 2026-11-04 row. That gap is composition, not direction: equity structure fell 1.26 points because the 63 session new low share eased to 0.2611 from 0.2994 while the new high share rose to 0.0701, volatility fell 0.72 points because 20 day realized volatility slipped to 12.8463, and trend added 0.57 points because the settled close left SPY 5.055 percent above its 200 day average and 1.5762 percent off its 52 week high. The rally is K shaped: consumer electronics, gaming and digital advertising rose 3.3742, 4.2797 and 3.7637 percent, while memory, data centres and semiconductor equipment fell 8.5122, 7.2643 and 5.6477 percent - and the memory row is the Korea session, where SK Hynix fell 9.4556 and Samsung 7.5688 percent. Overnight Asia is the same story from the other side: KOSPI fell as much as 5 percent intraday and program trading tripped circuit breakers, Hong Kong tech ran a 5th straight session, and 7 of 11 A-share names rose for a mean of 0.1658 percent. Europe brings a different problem: the latest euro area monthly inflation print is the highest since 2023 and year-end hike expectations are building, while the dollar index sits at 121.6656 and the 10 year at 4.95. Into the US open, index futures are reported up more than 300 points, but Qualcomm is indicated near 10 percent lower after blaming its weak guidance on memory costs.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 contributes 7.50 points, the largest single item. 4 of 8 scoring legs stand: the dollar index at 121.6656 above 105, the real rate at 2.65 above 1.5, small caps 4.5435 points behind over 63 sessions, and the gold leg also scoring. Three of those legs are standing levels that do not move with the tape, so the dimension held at 0.50.

Liquidity and credit at 77.46 is still the highest dimension. High yield OAS at 3.40 sits at the 86.5 percentile and contributes 6.92 points, investment grade at 0.93 sits at the 75.38 percentile, and the overnight reverse repo fell to 0.225 from 0.427, which the neutral deviation mapping reads as the facility running dry. The dimension added nothing net to the score today.

Equity structure at 69.68 is the largest drag today at 0.252 points. The 63 session new low share is 0.2611, or 41 of 157 names, the new high share is 0.0701, or 11 of 157, semis relative strength is 15.1914 points behind over 63 sessions, and the share above the 200 day average is 0.3871. Highs and lows both present means rotation, not a broad selloff.

Macro at 74.07. The 10 year rose to 4.95 from 4.91 and the real rate to 2.65 from 2.62, together contributing 9.6265 points; the 2s10s curve is 0.34 and the 2 year is 4.61. These are the 2026-11-03 prints, not an intraday level from today.

Volatility at 48.33 is the second largest drag at 0.108 points. VIX fell from 21.15 to 20.83 and contributes 5.752 points, while 20 day realized volatility fell from 13.2356 to 12.8463. The implied side is not pricing this AI hardware pullback; the realized side is falling instead.

supporting_signals.claim: Memory is the epicentre, and the reading is the Korea session: SK Hynix fell 9.4556 percent, Samsung 7.5688 percent and the memory theme 8.5122 percent. Korean press reports, relayed through the Chinese aggregators, quote the finance minister saying he is prepared for wider market volatility - second-hand aggregation, not a first-party statement.

The whole AI hardware chain sold off: data centres 7.2643 percent, semiconductor equipment 5.6477 percent, AI infrastructure 4.9778 percent, with MU down 7.0015 percent and NVDA down 3.1738 percent. AMD rose 1.0085 percent on the same tape, so this is not indiscriminate selling.

Semis relative strength is 15.1914 points behind over 63 sessions, and that is not a one day reading: placed in a quarterly window, AI hardware has been lagging for more than a quarter, which makes it structural rather than event driven.

Rates press in the same direction: the 10 year at 4.95 and the real rate at 2.65 are both above the 2026-11-03 prior prints of 4.91 and 2.62, so the discount rate on long duration, high multiple assets has not improved.

contradicting_signals.claim: The index level has not broken: after settlement SPY sits 1.5762 percent off its 52 week high and 5.055 percent above its 200 day average, and the trend dimension rose 0.57 points.
Breadth improved rather than deteriorated: the 63 session new low share fell to 0.2611 from 0.2994, or 41 of 157 names against 47 before, and the new high share rose to 0.0701 from 0.0637.
Credit is not confirming the equity stress: high yield OAS tightened to 3.40 from 3.43, investment grade to 0.93 from 0.94, and bitcoin at 80295 is up 2.17919 percent over 24 hours.

Consumer and platform names are absorbing the flow: consumer electronics 3.3742 percent, gaming 4.2797 percent, digital advertising 3.7637 percent and internet platforms 2.3575 percent. The consumer electronics row reads the Asia session, with Xiaomi up 8.8317 percent and Hon Hai down 2.0833 percent.

The mainland close was mixed but tilted up: Tongfu Microelectronics rose 6.8982 percent, JCET 3.6529 percent, while Ingenic fell 3.5748 percent and ChangXin Memory 3.5382 percent, and 7 of 11 names rose for a mean of 0.1658 percent. Packaging is up while memory design is down, the opposite of the Korean memory rout.

what_changed_today: The risk score is 63.77, 0.30 points below the 2026-11-04 row at 64.07; the weighted split is 0.252 from equity structure, 0.108 from volatility, 0.057 from trend and 0.002 from macro.

The 2026-11-04 close is now the settled value: SPY is up 1.6518 percent against 1.8625 percent in last night's post-bell snapshot, so the 2026-11-04 row written after the bell has already been settlement revised once and must be quoted with that distinction.
The rates vintage rolled forward one day: the 10 year at 4.95 from 4.91, the real rate at 2.65 from 2.62, and the 2s10s curve at 0.34 from 0.32.
VIX is 20.83 from 21.15 and 20 day realized volatility is 12.8463 from 13.2356, both saying volatility is not following the AI hardware pullback.
The A-share close: 7 of 11 names rose for a mean of 0.1658 percent, sharply narrower than 10.6763 percent in the prior session, so yesterday's broad follow-through did not extend.

Sector rotation: memory at 8.5122 percent and data centres at 7.2643 percent led the decline, gaming at 4.2797 percent and digital advertising at 3.7637 percent led the advance, and 12 of the 22 rows rose against 10 falling.
watch_next: The US Employment Situation at 2026-11-06 13:30Z is the week's highest weight event: the last payroll print added only 29 thousand jobs with unemployment at 4.2 percent, so another soft number forces the rates and dollar combination to be repriced.

US CPI on 2026-11-10: the latest monthly CPI is 3.71725 percent with core PCE at 3.12116 percent, inflation leaves no room for cuts, and that is the same backdrop behind the euro area year-end hike expectations.
The second Korea session: whether 000660.KS and 005930.KS stop falling decides if the AI hardware lag is a one day event or a new leg down.

The memory cost pass-through: Qualcomm blamed its weak guidance on memory prices and Nintendo's Switch 2 sales fell 41 percent on the same cost pressure; if it keeps passing through, hardware margin cuts spread into consumer electronics.

Threshold watch: breadth at 0.3871 sits only 0.0371 above the 0.35 stress rung, and VIX at 20.83 has to fall back under 20 with momentum turning positive before the regime can move from indeterminate to risk_on.

bull_case.title: Bull case: rotation broadens and breadth reclaims 0.40
points: If the AI hardware lag stops and consumer and platform leadership pushes the 63 session new low share below 0.20, equity structure can step down another notch.
If VIX falls from 20.83 back under 20 while momentum turns positive, the regime can move from indeterminate to risk_on and the score has room toward 60.

base_case.title: Base case: indeterminate persists and the score holds in the mid 60s
points: The score oscillates in a 60 to 70 range with only equity structure and volatility moving among the 6 dimensions, while macro and liquidity credit stay frozen.
The index level keeps being absorbed by platforms and consumer names, AI hardware keeps splitting internally, and the 22 rows stay mixed.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the memory shock spreads into US semis
points: If the Korean memory decline carries into the US session and MU and NVDA step lower again, semis relative strength widens beyond 15.1914 and equity structure pushes back above 70.
With the 10 year at 4.95 and the real rate at 2.65, if credit starts to widen from a high yield OAS of 3.40 the score risks a push toward 70.
